matched_articles.summary: Kia 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Kia looks to roll out multiple powertrains to meet India demand'이다. Kia India is preparing electric, hybrid, and CNG models for the Indian market. The company acknowledges a huge burden in predicting customer powertrain preferences. Its new Sorento SUV launches with hybrid and diesel options. Kia plans further hybrid and electric vehicle introductions by 2030. Affordability will significantly influence electrified powertrain market penetration. Kia plans further hybrid and electric vehicle introductions by 2030 Strong sales of CNG cars, which Kia hadn't anticipated, highlights how quickly customer preferences can shift in India The introduction of the Sorento marks the start of Kia's multi-powertrain strategy , with the company also announcing its entry into the CNG market with the Carens and Carens Clavis models Kia also plans to introduce a hybrid version of the Seltos in 2027, while it showcased a hybrid version of the Carnival minivan on Friday Kia is targeting sales of 410,000 vehicles in India by 2030, with eight of 10 new models planned for the market expected to be electrified, including hybrids.

matched_articles.title: Kia builds E20 readiness into India strategy as it expands powertrain options
matched_articles.summary: Kia 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Kia builds E20 readiness into India strategy as it expands powertrain options'이다. Kia India is preparing its vehicle portfolio for higher ethanol fuel blends. The automaker has developed engineering capabilities for fuel blends from E20 to E100. This flexible-fuel technology is part of a broader multi-powertrain strategy. Kia is also expanding its hybrid, CNG, and electric vehicle offerings. The company is ready to adapt as India's fuel ecosystem evolves. Kia is also expanding its hybrid, CNG, and electric vehicle offerings Also read: Kia enters India’s hybrid passenger vehicle market with 3-row SUV Sorento "As part of this readiness, Kia is showcasing a flexible-fuel concept Live Events Atul Sood, Senior Vice President of Sales and Marketing at Kia India said that the automaker is only displaying that the technology option for E20-E100 is available with the Syros SUV and so if needed, they have it ready for adoption Kia's E20 readiness comes as the company expands its choices in India, including the introduction of the Sorento hybrid, while continuing to develop CNG and electric offerings For Kia, the E20-E100 engineering capability provides another layer of flexibility as the Indian market moves towards higher ethanol blending.
